human_review.source: v11 PaperInterface claim surface; human entries are recorded after direct review

human_summary_review.note: Machine-checked proof and automated semantic-audit evidence do not constitute human approval. Do not mark this summary human-approved without explicit review.

main_caveat: No theorem-level formalization boundary is recorded. The Section 4--5 operational reading of stability is documented as a source clarification while the page-10 replacement-pair definition remains literal.

llm_assumption_review.policy: Every paper-facing theorem premise not derived from prior Lean declarations must be declared in Assumptions.lean, listed in assumption_names, and judged as an exact paper/source model condition rather than a proof assumption. GS62 has no configured assumption declarations.

llm_paper_coverage_review.policy: Use the byte-pinned source-first normal named-theory inventory: the two displayed college definitions, the Section 3 prose definition of unstable marriage, Theorem 1, and Theorem 2. Examples, proof-local terminology, standalone algorithm claims, and ordinary prose require deep-paper review and cannot receive normal source-coverage credit. Section 4 procedure semantics remain a required semantic component of Theorem 2.

llm_source_record_review.policy: Classify every boundary-shaped input and recursive procedure field from expanded semantic content. Bare carrier data are witness data; proposition-valued fields require exact source evidence or a checked Lean derivation. Do not infer source fidelity from record, field, theorem, or function names.

llm_statement_review.policy: For every selected source claim, compare only its exact byte-pinned raw source-anchor bundle and Lean's expanded transparent `...Spec : Prop` target. The paired proof endpoint receives separate Lean-Meta proof credit; a name, paraphrase, wrapper, or prior aggregate receipt is not a semantic match. Review every retained paper-local prerequisite and every material library prerequisite before the dependent claim.

semantic_model_review.policy: Review every expanded paper-facing model and procedure surface semantically against the pinned source. In particular, inspect mutual application eligibility, batched top-q roster updates, termination, quota feasibility, and the literal-versus-completed stability boundary. Record not-applicable only after inspecting each requested dimension; names are routing only.

source_proof_fidelity_review.policy: Schema 2 records source-proof defects separately from formalization gaps. The literal page-10 stability definition, the completed Sections 4--5 operational reading, and the exact Section 4 procedure semantics are reviewed by source locator and mathematical content, not by Lean declaration names.
